simulation_metadata.exercise_title: Phase 8 Controlled Operational Incident & Recovery Drill
simulation_metadata.target_vantage: Rasoolpura Metro Elevated Walkway (Concourse Station Level +4.8m)

incident_event.incident_description: During dry run observation logging, wind gusts exceeded the 35 km/h safety ceiling (measured 46.5 km/h) and a simulated lightning alert triggered within 10 km (6.2 km). Simultaneously, physical curb reference marker #3 sustained temporary visual obstruction from splashback.
incident_event.note: Per safety policy, Sahaay AI does NOT perform autonomous emergency dispatch or road closure.

activation_gate_transition.justification: Environmental hazard threshold exceeded (wind 46.5 km/h, lightning 6.2 km) + curb reference obstruction.

data_handling.quarantine_reason: Incomplete verification prior to environmental abort

root_cause_analysis.physical_inspection_status: Vantage railing and curb reference marker #3 inspected and undamaged.

human_authorization_signoff.notes: Weather system passed north-east; Rasoolpura concourse vantage confirmed safe; resumed supervised dry run.
